reading.body:
This record cannot be read as a data center campus. The OpenStreetMap entry tagged as OptimumHQ at 1955 South Val Vista Drive, Mesa, refers to OptimumAI, a software company that builds enterprise resource planning and customer relationship management tools. The operator's own published address is 70 South Val Vista Drive, Suite A3-120, in neighboring Gilbert, Arizona, not Mesa. No data center specifications, power capacity, or colocation services are published for this location.

The registry maps 56 facilities across Arizona, of which only four have published power capacity. This entry cannot be ranked or compared to the state's published capacity of 512 megawatts, as no power figure exists for it.

This site does not assert operator, capacity, or colocation status for this entry. The OpenStreetMap record appears to be a miscategorization of a software vendor's office address rather than a genuine data center facility.
